article.headline: St. Thomas earns 119-82 win over Macalester
article.description: — Brogan Madson scored 23 points as St. Thomas beat Macalester 119-82 on Wednesday.
article.linkText: St. Thomas earns 119-82 win over Macalester
article.story: ST. PAUL, Minn. -- — Brogan Madson scored 23 points as St. Thomas beat Macalester 119-82 on Wednesday. Madson added three steals for the Tommies (2-2). Hayden Tibbits scored 19 points and added five assists. Kendall Blue had 16 points and went 6 of 10 from the field (3 for 6 from 3-point range). Logan Davis finished with 17 points for the Scots. Kaden Holdbrook and Owen Walther each added 12 points. Up next St. Thomas visits Army in its next matchup on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
